scope: Archive-only NEW inverse diagnostics on the already checked order2 Kerr patch. No new ray/path/root or neural training. Not a global recoverability certificate.
measurement: Same 128 integrated light measurements and full-area diagonal covariance as inverse004; cached physical reference q16 primary; q10 independent resolution check; classical33 q24 check.
source_norm: RMS contrast on the SAME 4736 chart-induced source/time points used by inverse004, equal weights. Not continuous volume norm.

source_dictionary.spatial_temporal_factors: open uniform cubic B-splines in r and tbar; Legendre degree0,1,2 in scaled source phi
source_dictionary.source_orthonormalization: SVD of synthesis/sqrt(N); retain source singular values above1e-9 times largest; store discarded rank and condition numbers. No jitter.

saved_networks: All 12 q8 models: 2scenarios x2methods x3seeds; old q3 results remain unchanged and are not new fits.
readback: orthogonal source-error energies: operational modes, remaining retained modes, outside dictionary
truth projection error and detector response of projection remainder
pairwise seed differences in observable and weak subspaces
candidate_correction: Freeze each neural field; add source-normalized modes with amplitude*s>=threshold to remove its residual projected on their left singular vectors. A single deterministic linear correction, no optimization. Compare to pure spectral reconstruction and original field. Keep negative or worse outcomes.
validation: Re-evaluate corrected detector response with physical q10 vsq16 and frozen chart q24. Include forward operator difference and correction-specific noise-whitened discrepancy. No continuum-bound claim from pair agreement.
target_nuisance_stress: Existing two known pulse amplitudes; retain original7 background functions and add each spline dictionary as unknown nuisance. Reorthonormalize combined nuisance on source grid; profile at1e-8/1e-10/1e-12 response rank tolerances. No dynamics penalty counted as data information; singular values below numerical error get unresolved/zero-compatible status, not invented confidence.
ambiguity_witness: In largest class, project a fixed smooth trial onto numerical response nullspace (rtol1e-10); fallback first numerical-null right vector if projection vanishes. Normalize RMS; scale amplitude min(0.1,0.5/max|witness|) over declared evaluation/ref10/ref16/q24 sets. Show1plus/minus mode remain positive at checked points. Store source separation and physical q10/q16 data differences. Samplewise positivity not uniform positivity proof.
reporting: Explicit basis/noise/norm dependence; weak does not mean exact null. Existing sources previously inspected, so development readback not fresh holdout. No claims about more than one patch or an actual telescope.
registration: Written before new spectra/source decompositions/corrections; commit protocol and source hashes before numerical outcomes. Code/source bug corrections require new additive attempt and disclosure, not threshold change.
